$schema_note: Tracked exceptions for frontend npm audit (mirrors .trivyignore doctrine: every entry carries a REVIEW BY date; scripts/check-npm-audit-exemptions.py fails CI if any date passes, if any audit finding is not covered here, if an exemption stops matching a finding, or if npm reports a NON-major fix path for an exempted advisory (fixAvailable without isSemVerMajor) - that means a real fix shipped and the exemption must go. The gate step IS this checker; the raw `npm audit --audit-level=high` it replaces would fail open (a passing audit proves nothing about coverage), while this checker fails CLOSED: without this file, any finding at all is red.

exceptions.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
exceptions.affectedChain: braces <- micromatch <- fast-glob <- chokidar <- tailwindcss@3 (dependency) ; braces <- micromatch <- fast-glob <- knip@5 (devDependency)
exceptions.reason: No released fix: the advisory covers every published braces (<=3.0.3, and 3.0.3 IS the latest version). npm's only resolution path is a semver-major migration - tailwindcss 3 -> 4 (drops the chokidar/fast-glob chain) and knip 5 -> 6 - which is a separate, owner-sized frontend slice, not a lockfile bump.
exceptions.exitCriterion: Remove when tailwind v4 (or another release breaking the chain) lands; scripts/check-npm-audit-exemptions.py already fails CI the moment npm reports a non-major fix path, so this entry cannot silently outlive its premise.

exceptions.title: Seroval: `fromJSON()` Promise thenable assimilation invokes plugin-produced callables (bypass of GHSA-mv8w-475r-vwqw)
exceptions.reason: Advisory published in the 2026-10-05/06 window; fixed in seroval 1.6.2, but the only requirer in this tree pins solid-js ~1.5.4 which caps seroval <1.6 - npm's sole resolution path is the semver-major @tanstack/react-query-devtools -> 5.102.8 migration (which moves the solid line). No app code imports solid-js or seroval (measured: 0 references under frontend/src); the chain is reached only through react-query-devtools' internal state serialization, and the deserialization input there is the query cache this same app serialized - not an attacker-supplied document.
exceptions.exitCriterion: Remove when @tanstack/react-query-devtools ships a line where solid-js admits seroval >=1.6.2; the checker already fails CI the moment npm reports a non-major fix path.

exceptions.title: Seroval: Memory exhaustion via unchecked TypedArray length in JSON deserialization
exceptions.reason: Same chain and same blocked-major premise as GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c above: fix is seroval 1.6.3, solid-js ~1.5.4 caps the installed tree at <1.6, and npm's only fix path is the major devtools->5.102.8 migration.
exceptions.exitCriterion: Remove together with GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c when the solid-js cap lifts; the checker fails CI the moment npm reports a non-major fix path.

exceptions.title: PostCSS: Quadratic complexity in flat selector parsing allows CPU exhaustion
exceptions.affectedChain: postcss-selector-parser@6.1.4 <- postcss-nested@^6.2.0 <- tailwindcss@3 (build-time CSS generation only)
exceptions.reason: Fix is postcss-selector-parser 7.1.6, but tailwindcss@3 pins postcss-nested ^6.2.0, which pins postcss-selector-parser ^6.1.x - npm's only fix path is the tailwindcss 3 -> 4.3.3 semver-major migration (the same migration the braces entry above is blocked on). Build-time-only chain: the production image copies /app/dist into nginx, the parser ships in neither the runtime image nor any request path, and the advisory needs attacker-controlled CSS input.
exceptions.exitCriterion: Remove when tailwind v4 lands (shares the exit with the braces entry) or postcss-nested 6.x reopens ^7; the checker fails CI the moment npm reports a non-major fix path.
